title: PAR-03/PAR-04 associative-action value-kind parser coverage
scope: Add direct fast coverage for each value category the associative-action parser currently consumes
Retain fail-closed behavior for recognized value categories without an action-specific decoder
Register a focused CTest selector to avoid rerunning the broad object-vector test for this slice

localSource.finding: The typed action reader consumes Real, Int16, Int32, String, and Handle categories; it has no Int8 decoder and rejects unimplemented ObjectId, Int64, Point3d, Bool, Binary, and Invalid categories.

libreDwgCrossCheck.finding: The inspected general group-code-to-value-category table agrees with the local dwgResbufValueKind mapping for the tested codes.
libreDwgCrossCheck.limit: Mutable master source, not pinned peer evidence and not an authority for AcDbAssocAction-specific DWG payload serialization.

odaDwgSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaDwgSpecification.finding: The available ODA specification does not provide the class-specific associative-action value-parameter grammar; no wire-width assumption is justified by the generic resbuf category map.

generatedTests: tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp now generates AC1024 action vectors for Real 40, Int16 70, Int32 90, String 1/1000/1005, and Handle 5/105/320.
Each supported control re-reads its encoded group code, requires successful typed publication, and verifies a following 3-bit body sentinel.
Int8 280 joins the generated fail-closed cases; unsupported vectors still cover ObjectId 350, Int64 160, Point3d 10, Bool 290, Binary 1004, and Invalid 700.

assessment.confirmedLocalResult: The currently supported parser categories have generated alignment/sentinel coverage; unsupported categories remain fail-closed.
unresolved: Exact AcDbAssocAction value-parameter DWG payload grammar and producer serialization evidence
Typed decoding and semantic interpretation for unsupported categories
External/native qualification and independent ACIS/ACDS semantic evidence
assessment.nextAction: Continue another locally evidenced PAR implementation item without waiting on external qualification; revisit action-value decoding only with an authoritative class-specific layout or traceable producer witness.
